ab_drive.case: post-entry bar closed below breakout level, latest bar recovered above it
ab_drive.direction: treatment exits the failed breakout the control rides to the 96h deadline

decision_record.calculation: Fixture: failure bar 3 bars before the latest, latest recovered above the level. Baseline exits 0, treatment exits 1 (full position qty). Cost of the miss: position rides up to the 96h deadline in a dead thesis, paying the 10bp exit fee later at an uncontrolled price instead of at the failure.
decision_record.comparison: Frozen baseline (switch OFF): structural exit inspected ONLY the latest completed 4h bar. Comparator at decision time: any post-entry bar, same bars/funding/position fixtures.
decision_record.experiment: Paired A/B on identical fixtures (tests/test_edge_batch6_blockers.py): control 0 intents vs treatment 1 exit for both sleeves; latest-bar failure fires under BOTH rules; pre-entry failure bars ignored; rejection rule = any A/B diff in the wrong direction or a pre-entry bar triggering.
decision_record.mechanism: Risk-service provision (funding squeeze) with an event-based exit trigger; the leak is responsiveness — an event print that is no longer the latest bar is invisible to the baseline.
decision_record.transfer: Shorts paying negative funding are squeezed when price breaks out; the sleeve warehouses the long side of that squeeze. Its designed protection is the structural exit: the breakout failing means the squeeze thesis is dead.
